description: Guide the student to aggregate tick-level data into OHLCV bars with proper timestamp handling and basic microstructure quality checks.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: I got a file with lots of tiny tick updates. How do I turn that into normal candle bars?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I need a pandas recipe to resample tick data into OHLCV bars and validate timestamp ordering/duplicates.
student_openings.advanced_quant: I want a robust tick-to-bar aggregation workflow with microstructure sanity checks (ordering, stale ticks, session boundaries).

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Tutor provides level-appropriate guidance for converting ticks into OHLCV bars, including timestamp normalization/order checks and practical bar-quality validation.
required_capabilities: Resample tick-level data into OHLCV bars
